acquisition_method.evidence: Using a data-dependent acquisition (DDA) method, the 15 most abundant precursor ions (charge states: 2+ to 4+) were selected for MS/MS fragmentation (dynamic exclusion, 40 seconds).
experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
Mass spectra were acquired in positive ion mode using a scheduled MRM-MS method targeting ≥3 transition pairs per peptide.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Each tumor or calibration sample was denatured with sodium deoxycholate (DOC), reduced with tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP), alkylated with iodoacetamide (IAA), and quenched with dithiothreitol (DTT).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Digestion was performed with tosyl phenylalanyl chloromethyl ketone (TCPK)-treated trypsin (substrate-to-enzyme ratio of 2:1, 1 hour, 37°C), prior to quenching with tosyllysine chloromethylketone (TLCK).

collision_energy.evidence: MS2 spectra were acquired following HCD fragmentation (normalized CE, 28), with an isolation width of 1.2 Da (resolution, 17,500; AGC target, 2 × 104; max injection time, 64 ms).

enrichment_method.evidence: Immunoenrichment was achieved by tumbling samples overnight at 4°C with antipeptide antibodies (Signatope GmbH) coupled to magnetic beads.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS2 spectra were acquired following HCD fragmentation (normalized CE, 28), with an isolation width of 1.2 Da (resolution, 17,500; AGC target, 2 × 104; max injection time, 64 ms).

instrument.evidence: Mass spectra were acquired on a Q-Exactive Plus MS with a Nanospray Flex ion source (RRID:SCR_020556, ThermoFisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: Mass spectra were acquired on a Q-Exactive Plus MS with a Nanospray Flex ion source (RRID:SCR_020556, ThermoFisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: A 2-µL aliquot of the AKT-depleted supernatant from each sample’s immunoenrichment, corresponding to 117.5 ng of total protein digest, was reserved for label-free quantitation of the global proteome.
